basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old living in a bustling part of Melbourne, working full-time in retail. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time gaming on my PS4, particularly in Rainbow Six Siege and occasionally on Injustice Mobile. I have a keen interest in personal finance as I'm looking to manage my debt better and start saving for the future. I'm usually online in the evenings and late nights, especially after work. I'm also trying to learn more about mental health resources in my area.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a high school education and have been working in retail for several years. I'm self-taught in personal finance, primarily through online resources and community discussions. My interest in technology and gaming has grown through personal exploration and interacting with other enthusiasts online.
